Ingredients and where they come from

Cake is the gate for every breeding chain, and it needs Honey, Red Berries, Milk, Eggs and Wheat. Milk comes from ranch Pals rather than gathering, which is why a working ranch matters more than a bigger field early on. The links below cover the drop sources for each ingredient.

Why food is the real bottleneck

Every working Pal consumes food, and a hungry Pal stops working and eventually weakens. That makes food production the true limit on how large a base can get, ahead of station count or Pal slots. The practical order is: get a stable berry or wheat farm running, then add a ranch for Milk and Eggs, then start producing Cake — because Cake is the ingredient every breeding chain depends on. Build the pipeline before you build the breeding pens, not after.
